author: NetworkChuck
description:
OpenAI's DevDay just wrapped with 20+ announcements. I'm going live to sort through them with you: what you can actually use today, what's still rolling out, and what's hype.

  We'll cover Dots (OpenAI's new always-on agents) and how they compare to Grok Bot, GPT-6.1 Sol, the new Decisions API and what it means for TypeSafe's Jev, the Pro 500 plan and Ultrafast, and what didn't get announced.
  Bring your questions. My full Jev video comes out Monday.

  Topics: OpenAI DevDay 2026, OpenAI Dots, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast, Decisions API, TypeSafe Jev, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Pro 500, Codex cloud, Agents API computer use.
